post.summary: Create a new record in a collection
Upload file(s) for a collection record
post.description: Uploads one or more files associated with a collection using multipart form data. Governed by the collection's create_rule (or update_rule) access policy: callers who do not have permission to create records for the collection cannot upload files. Multipart parts named after a File column of the collection enforce that column's max_size (bytes), mime_types (wildcards like image/* and */* are supported), and pattern (regex matched against the original file name); a single-file column (no max or max: 1) rejects more than one part for the same field name, while a multi-file column (max > 1 or min > 1) accepts up to max parts. Returns the stored file records with the id/key to use when creating or updating records. Note: Singular aliases /collection/{name}/record/upload and /collections/{name}/record/upload are also supported.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the target collection in the database (e.g. 'posts', 'articles', 'users'). Note: The collection must already exist.

files.description: Multiple file payloads to upload at once

400.description: Invalid multipart payload, no file provided, a field constraint violation (max_size, mime_types, pattern, or max item count), or multiple parts for a single-file column

403.description: Forbidden - user lacks permission to create records in this collection

404.description: Collection not found - the specified collection name does not exist in the database
